the algorithms for exact admission control have low computational complexity, and the algorithms for discretized admission control are practical and can admit almost as many flows as exact admission control.
the algorithms for exact and discretized admission control are efficient, and that the discretized version is more efficient and has a performance degradation that is acceptable.

(1) the algorithms for flow admission at an EDF scheduler have very low complexity; (2) discretization of the traffic envelopes can be used to reduce this complexity further; (3) discretization leads to small relative performance degradation in terms of the number and types of flows admitted.
